Pioneiro no país em gestão de serviços oncológicos, aOncoclínicas&Co foi fundada em 2010 e hoje é um dos maiores centros de oncologia, hematologia e radioterapia da América Latina.

Na essência daOncoclínicas&Co , o paciente é o centro de tudo.É para ele que buscamos os mais avançados tratamentos e o mais alto nível de qualidade e segurança.Temos como pilares de atuação o acolhimento e a inovação no tratamento oncológico e a atenção integral e personalizada, com um olhar no indivíduo.

Aqui na OC valorizamos a diversidade e buscamos promover uma cultura inclusiva onde as pessoas se sintam pertencentes. Acreditamos que a inovação nasce de um ambiente diverso, com diferentes perspectivas e vivências.

O que você irá fazer:

Desenvolver, sob supervisão, atividades de complexidade restrita em assistência farmacêutica relacionadas ao recebimento, armazenamento, manipulação, preparo e dispensação de medicamentos e materiais médico-hospitalares, assegurando a assistência terapêutica na promoção, proteção e recuperação da saúde dos pacientes dentro dos padrões de qualidade e segurança do paciente garantindo o cumprimento das legislações vigentes e boas práticas conforme área de atuação dentro da abrangência determinada pela liderança do cargo.

  • Analisar a prescrição médica de acordo com o protocolo estabelecido por órgãos reguladores e normas internas do Grupo;
  • Acondicionar e organizar os materiais médico-hospitalares e medicamentos recebidos no estoque da farmácia da clínica;
  • Prestar orientações básicas e de rotina aos pacientes sobre procedimentos e protocolos a serem seguidos em relação a assistência farmacêutica durante o tratamento;
  • Levantar informações para o controle de estoque de medicamentos e materiais médico-hospitalares da clínica, identificando necessidade de aquisição, substituição ou outra ação para assegurar a disponibilidade de medicamentos em tempo hábil e com segurança ao paciente;
  • Manipulação de pré-quimioterapia e quimioterapia conforme procedimento operacional padrão;
  • Realizar o acondicionamento e descarte de resíduos de insumos e materiais médico-hospitalares nas clínicas, conforme procedimentos e protocolos estabelecidos.
  • Zelar pela conservação dos bens patrimoniais, solicitando manutenção, reparo e/ou reposição, sempre que necessário;
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas, a critério do superior imediato.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Farmácia + registro CRF
  • Especialização em Oncologia – Completa
  • Experiência anterior em Oncologia, análise de prescrições e familiaridade com manuseio de medicações oncológicas.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

description:
Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.

Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.

Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo(B3) e Nova Iorque(NYSE).

description:
Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

Darkroom is hiring a Creator Manager to lead client-facing creator strategy and execution across our Creator Services division. This role owns the relationship between brands and our creator network - ensuring campaigns are strategically aligned, operationally sound, and performance-driven across platforms, including TikTok Shop, Amazon affiliate, LTK, YouTube, and other emerging commerce channels.

As a Creator Manager, you will serve as the primary point of contact for both clients and creators. You will shape activation strategy, oversee execution, and ensure creator output drives measurable impact while maintaining a strong creator experience. If you thrive at the intersection of relationships, strategy, and commerce - this role was built for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Creator Strategy & Client Leadership: Lead creator and influencer strategy across client accounts, serving as the primary client-facing point of contact - presenting strategy, performance insights, and optimization recommendations.
  • Campaign Execution: Own end-to-end execution of creator campaigns, including sourcing, vetting, contracting, onboarding, and performance tracking.
  • Platform Activation: Activate creators across TikTok Shop, affiliate programs, paid UGC, Amazon, LTK, YouTube, and other emerging channels.
  • Commerce & Creative Alignment: Partner with the Account team and Content Studio to align creator efforts to hero SKUs, commission strategy, and creative frameworks.
  • Performance Monitoring: Track campaign performance and proactively recommend optimization opportunities.
  • Network & Operations: Manage usage rights, timelines, deliverables, CRM systems, and Darkroom's creator network infrastructure.
  • Team Development: Mentor junior team members and help scale best practices within Creator Services.

Who You Are

  • 3–6 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, UGC, or affiliate programs.
  • Strong client management experience and comfort leading strategy conversations.
  • Deep understanding of creator workflows, usage rights, and cross-platform activation.
  • Experience with TikTok Shop and affiliate models preferred; exposure to Amazon affiliate, LTK, or YouTube Shopping is a plus.
  • Analytical and performance-oriented, with the ability to translate creator output into measurable impact.
  • Highly organized and confident managing multiple clients and creator pipelines simultaneously.
  • Strong communicator with a creator-first mindset and commercial awareness.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote, employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model, including weekly in-office appearances. Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements

description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

title: F&B Concessions Coordinator
description:
F&B Concessions Coordinator

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Working alongside the FIFA/FIFA27 Partnership Rights Delivery (PRD) team and reporting to the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager in Zurich and the FIFA27 Senior F&B Concessions Manager, the F&B Concessions Coordinator supports the operational planning and delivery of the Public Food and Beverage (F&B) Concessions Programme for stadium spectators and fulfillment of FIFA’s Commercial Partners’ contractual rights and obligations across all stadiums at the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. The objective is to implement and deliver successfully the FIFA Commercial Partners’ exclusive food & beverage rights.

This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful tournament through the delivery of FIFA’s commercial operations in the host country. The role operates under the supervision of the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager and the FIFA27 Senior F&B Concessions Manager and does not carry direct commercial ownership or decision-making authority over F&B concessionaire or Commercial Partner agreements.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • The main responsibilities of the F&B Concessions Coordinator for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ encompass supporting the planning, coordination, and operational delivery of the F&B Concessions Programme, including but not limited to:
  • Support the implementation of the Public F&B Concessions Programme across all eight stadiums, including timeline tracking, milestone follow-up, and coordination of deliverables.
  • Assist in integrating Commercial Partner products and services within the F&B Concessions Programme.
  • Support the planning and operational implementation of the commercial rights granted to FIFA’s Commercial Partners within the F&B Concessions Programme.
  • Coordinate with appointed F&B Concessionaire(s), service providers, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth information flow and execution of services within the F&B Concessions project.
  • Provide administrative and organisational support throughout the F&B concessionaire tender (RFP) and other related F&B related tender processes, including documentation management, evaluation support, reporting and assistance in market research activities.
  • Support the review, mapping, preparation, and optimisation of onsite F&B infrastructure and facilities across all official stadiums, ensuring proper documentation and tracking of action points.
  • Track the development and implementation of F&B concepts and operations, menus, pricing, and onsite infrastructure across all stadiums, ensuring deadlines and requirements are met.
  • Coordinate logistics and administrative preparation for stadium inspections and Commercial Partner operational F&B site visits, preparing documentation and follow-up actions.
  • Support the creation and coordination of F&B-related signage and branding elements (e.g. menu boards).
  • Assist in defining and optimising the service and display of F&B Commercial Partners’ products, supporting alignment between internal and external stakeholders.
  • Prepare reports, presentations, dashboards, and tracking tools using Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, etc.).
  • Assist in developing and maintaining training materials, briefing documents, presentations and operational guidelines.
  • Assist with monitoring daily operations pre-tournament and during tournament time, ensuring proper documentation and reporting.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Catering, Hospitality Management, Event Management, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent level of education).

Experience

  • 2 - 4 years of professional experience in food & beverage, catering, hospitality, event management, or a related area.
  • Experience supporting F&B concessions or catering operations, ideally within large-scale international events, preferably in the sports industry
  • Exposure to project coordination and administrative support within complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Experience assisting in infrastructure or operational planning is considered an asset.

Skills & Competencies

  • Good understanding of the food & beverage concessions industry; experience in stadium or event environments is an advantage.
  • Basic knowledge of utilities and infrastructure requirements relevant to F&B operations (e.g. electricity, water supply).
  • Understanding of food safety and hygiene standards applicable to F&B operations.
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
  • Structured working style with high attention to detail and strong follow-up capabilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and under tight timelines.
  • Proactive and solution-oriented mindset with a service-focused approach to commercial rights delivery.

Certification & Requirements

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams; knowledge of Visio and MS Project is an advantage).
  • Experience using planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • Willingness to travel and work extended hours during peak project phases and tournament time.

Candidate Requirements:

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual - Portuguese and English
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro for the duration of the employment (pre-tournament and operational tournament time)

About Nu

Nu is the worlds largest digital banking platform outside of Asia serving over 117 million customers across Brazil Mexico and Colombia. title: ServiceNow Configuration Manager - Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)
description:
Configuration manager - ServiceNow

Are you looking for an opportunity in one of the largest tech companies in the Nordics? We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented ServiceNow Configuration Manager to take ownership of our Configuration Management process and ensure the quality, accuracy, and reliability of our ServiceNow CMDB. In this key role, you will help strengthen the foundation of our ITSM processes by maintaining auditable configuration data that drives stable operations and informed decision‑making across the organization.

Joining Tieto Indtech, Nexus unit as a ServiceNow Configuration manager

As a Configuration Manager , you will be responsible for leading the governance, data quality, and ongoing development of our ServiceNow CMDB. You will collaborate closely with Process Owners, Product Management, Customer Service functions, and the ServiceNow Platform Owner to ensure that configuration data remains trustworthy, complete, and aligned with our platform strategy and ITSM practices.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is passionate about structure, accuracy, and continuous improvement — and who enjoys influencing how the organization manages technology information at scale.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the Configuration Management process and ensure the health and quality of CMDB data.
  • Define, develop, and maintain CMDB governance policies, including CI class models, naming conventions, and lifecycle states.
  • Maintain and enhance the CMDB data model, structure, and CI relationships.
  • Ensure configuration data is accurate, complete, compliant, and supports ITSM processes.
  • Collaborate with Incident, Change, Problem, and other Process Owners to ensure correct usage of CI data.
  • Support stakeholders across the organization in product management and customer onboarding activities.
  • Lead CMDB audits and health checks, identifying gaps and driving corrective actions.
  • Define requirements for discovery, integrations, and data population into the CMDB.
  • Serve as the functional lead for CMDB-related tools and integrations in partnership with the ServiceNow Platform Owner.
  • Align configuration management practices with the overall ServiceNow platform strategy, architecture, and roadmap.

To rock this position, you own

  • Strong hands‑on experience with ServiceNow CMDB and configuration management practices.
  • Solid understanding of CMDB structure, CI relationships, lifecycle management , and data modelling.
  • Experience with running ITSM processes in ServiceNow.
  • Knowledge of ITIL and ITSM frameworks.
  • Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail and a drive for data quality.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross‑functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Ability to communicate complex information clearly across different teams.

Nice to have:

  • ServiceNow certifications (e.g., CMDB, Discovery, ITOM).
  • Experience of ServiceNow integrations, and data ingestion methods.
  • Experience supporting product onboarding or customer onboarding service processes in ServiceNow.
  • Familiarity with audit and compliance activities related to configuration data.

What’s in it for you?

  • A role with significant ownership and impact on our ITSM and platform strategy.
  • A collaborative environment partnering with skilled professionals across IT and business.
  • Opportunities for growth within the ServiceNow and ITOM ecosystem.
  • A chance to shape how the organization manages essential configuration and service data.
  • We offer a dynamic and challenging work environment where you can grow your skills and advance your career. We are committed to fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and customer focus.
  • We offer you professional growth, open culture and an outstanding work‑life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working. Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle where you need to unlearn and relearn every day as new possibilities emerge.

We offer:

  • The contract is for an indefinite period of time. We count on you!
  • Work partially or completely remote. Work from wherever it suits you.
  • Extra holidays. We have 25 days off plus 2 sick days.
  • We contribute from 10 400 CZK per year. You name it. Choose from contributions for pension and life insurance, sports, culture, health, travel or education in the cafeteria.
  • Educate yourself. We regularly organise and pay for IT courses, certifications, language training and personal development courses.
  • 123CZK meal allowance on top of your salary.
  • Reward for a new colleague. Refer another colleague to us and get up to 80,000 CZK.
  • We’ll support you when you’re sick. For colleagues who are seriously ill for a long period of time, we contribute to sick pay in excess of the law.
  • Extra work is appreciated. When overtime is needed, we pay more than the law requires.
  • Stay fit and fresh. In Ostrava, use the free fitness facilities in the building, in other locations, do sports with Multisport.
  • Nordic culture. At Tieto, we believe in you. No one is breathing down your neck and checking every minute of your work. We are friendly and open.

About Industry Nexus

Nexus supports its customers in business process automation by exchanging and sharing business information with their business partners. We have two service areas: Business Information eXchange (BIX) and Multichannel.

Nexus has a large existing customer base in the Nordics and is a growing business unit within Tietoevry Industry. With a unique combination of global capabilities and local presence, Nexus currently serves more than 4000 customers in 50+ countries around the world - creating a digital advantage for millions every day.

Join us and make your mark!

We look forward to your application!
Please attach your CV or LinkedIn-profile and we’ll reach out to you. Interviews will be held on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply today.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact Heli Huuhtanen, Head of Customer Experience Hub, via e-mail

About Tieto

Tieto creates purposeful technology that reinvents the world for good. We are a leading technology company with a strong Nordic heritage and global capabilities. Based on our core values of openness, trust and diversity, we work with our customers to develop digital futures where businesses, societies, and humanity thrive.

Our 24,000 experts globally specialize in cloud, data, and software, serving thousands of enterprises and public‑sector customers in more than 90 countries. Tieto’s annual turnover is approximately EUR 3 billion and the company’s shares are listed on the NASDAQ exchange in Helsinki and Stockholm, as well as on Oslo Bør.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

title: Mbar Energia - Mecânico De Manutenção (Usina Termelétrica)
description:
Mecânico de Manutenção (Usina Termelétrica)

Rio de Janeiro

Descrição da oferta de emprego

Somos a Âmbar, a empresa de geração e comercialização de energia do grupo J&F, o maior grupo privado do Brasil. Nosso amplo portfólio de ativos contribui para a expansão e diversificação da matriz energética do Brasil.

Temos 39 unidades de geração de energia, essenciais para a segurança no abastecimento de eletricidade. Nossas usinas fortalecem a transição energética sustentável para o país e para os nossos clientes. Somos o quarto maior gerador de energia a gás natural do Brasil em capacidade instalada. Possuímos ainda unidades hidrelétricas, solares, a biomassa, a carvão mineral e a biogás.

Respaldados pela solidez do grupo J&F, atuamos na comercialização de energia no Mercado Livre e em projetos de Geração Distribuída para clientes em todo o Brasil. Atuamos na gestão completa das contas, criando soluções personalizadas para consumidores e empresas de todos os portes.

Presente em mais de 190 países e com 70 anos de história, o grupo J&F tem um portfólio amplo de empresas. Entre elas estão a JBS, líder global em alimentos à base de proteína, além da Eldorado Brasil Celulose, J&F Mineração, Flora Higiene e Cosméticos, Picpay, Banco Original e Canal Rural.

Estamos em busca de um Mecânico que irá executar a manutenção mecânica preventiva, preditiva e corretiva em todos os equipamentos da usina, conforme as ordens de serviços de manutenção originadas pelo programa anual de manutenção, bem como as solicitações das ocorrências diárias de manutenção, com o intuito de atingir as metas de disponibilidade dos equipamentos.

  • Realizar as manutenções, preventiva, corretiva e preditiva de guisa segura, em equipamentos mecânicos tais como: turbina a gás e vapor, geradores e sistemas auxiliares, ETA, ETE, planta de desmineralização e de tratamento de óleo, compressores, válvulas, bombas, filtros, trocadores de calor, caldeiras HRSG, utilizando a de referência do plano de manutenção e das ordens de serviços, com o propósito de evitar problemas que causem paralização dos equipamentos e respectivamente da produção;
  • Preditiva, analisar e diagnosticar possíveis problemas em equipamentos, através de relatórios conclusivos, obtendo o diagnóstico em questão, a fim da tomada de decisão para resolução;
  • Analisar e medir as vibrações mecânicas nos equipamentos da usina, identificando folgas, desalinhamento das engrenagens dos mesmos, a fim de realizar reparos necessários;
  • Realizar análise de temperaturas dos equipamentos e identificar possíveis motivos de sobrecarga nos mesmos, a fim de sugerir a intervenção de manutenção devida para solucionar o problema;
  • Executar o plano de lubrificação mensal dos equipamentos, seguindo uma rota sequencial para este trabalho, a fim de evitar paralisações dos equipamentos causando prejuízos;
  • Garantir a qualidade dos serviços de manutenção prestados, através da obediência aos procedimentos da organização, a fim de manter a excelência dos resultados;
  • Auxiliar a melhoria contínua dos sistemas, através da implementação de projetos e modificações de rotinas e equipamentos, a fim de obter uma otimização rumo aos resultados;
  • Garantir a melhoria contínua da gestão de saúde, segurança, meio ambiente e social, seguindo a política de SSMA da empresa, reportando acidentes potenciais (quase acidentes, atos e condições inseguras), participando de reuniões e treinamentos de SSMA e tomando medidas que visem atenuar os riscos à saúde e segurança dos colaboradores e contratados em potencias impactos ambientais.
  • Ensino Médio/Técnico em Manutenção Mecânica ou Eletromecânica;
  • Necessário experiência em manutenção industrial em usinas térmelétricas;
  • Desejável conhecimento em Geradores de Energia, Turbina a Gás e Turbina a Vapor;
  • Conhecimento em Pacote office (Word e Excel);
  • NR10 e o SEP (Sistema Elétrico Potencia);
  • Ferramentaria e Equipamentos de Oficina (Torno, Esmeril e Prensa);
  • Conhecimento em Mecânica Industrial;
  • Conhecimento em Caldeira HRSG;
  • Conhecimento em Hidráulica e Pneumática;
  • Conhecimento de Alinhamento a Laser;
  • Conhecimento em Lubrificação;
  • Conhecimento em Análise de vibração;
  • Capacitação/Habilitação para operação de empilhadeira;

title: Data Engineer – Tieto Tech Consulting (m/f/d)
description:
Job Description

Tietoevry Create is inviting a talented Data Engineer to join our growing team and support our customer BICS , a global telecommunication enabler with a physical network spanning the globe. In this role, you will work on the BICS Voice and CC Value Streams, delivering qualified customer and network support by designing, building, and optimizing large-scale data pipelines within the telecom domain. The position requires strong expertise in Scala Spark , Databricks , and AWS cloud services , and focuses on developing high-performance data platforms that enable network analytics, customer insights, real-time monitoring, and regulatory reporting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable batch data pipelines using Scala, Databricks Spark, Databricks SQL and Airflow
  • Implement optimized ETL/ELT processes to ingest, cleanse, transform, and enrich large volumes of telecom network, usage, and operational data
  • Ensure pipeline reliability, observability, and performance tuning of Spark workloads
  • Build and manage data architectures leveraging AWS services (such as but not limited to) S3, Lambda, IAM, and CloudWatch
  • Implement infrastructure-as-code using Terraform
  • Ensure security best practices and compliance with telecom regulatory requirements (GDPR, Data sovereignty, retention)
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Architecture, DevOps, Network Engineering, Business Intelligence)
  • Document system designs, data flows, and best practices

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or Big Data Developer
  • Strong proficiency in Scala and functional programming concepts
  • Advanced experience with Apache Spark (batch processing using Data Frame API and low-level Spark API's, performance tuning, cluster optimization)
  • Experience with optimized SQL-based data transformations for analytics and machine learning workloads
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks including notebooks, jobs, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and MLflow (nice to have)
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD practices with Git, Jenkins/Gitlab Actions
  • Strong AWS skills: S3, Lambda, IAM, CloudWatch, and related services
  • Knowledge of distributed systems, data governance, and security best practices
  • Experience with Airflow integration with AWS services for end-to-end orchestration across cloud data pipelines
  • Experience with IaC tools: Terraform or CloudFormation
  • Experience with Python is a Plus
  • Experience with DBT is a Plus
  • Experience with Snowflake is a Plus

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High degree of ownership and a mindset for continuous improvement
  • Quality oriented, pragmatic and solution oriented
  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Experience in telecom sector is a plus
  • Experience with an agile way of working is a plus
  • English proficiency

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Job Description

Configuration manager - ServiceNow

Are you looking for an opportunity in one of the largest tech companies in the Nordics? We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented ServiceNow Configuration Manager to take ownership of our Configuration Management process and ensure the quality, accuracy, and reliability of our ServiceNow CMDB. In this key role, you will help strengthen the foundation of our ITSM processes by maintaining auditable configuration data that drives stable operations and informed decision‑making across the organization.

Joining Tieto Indtech, Nexus unit as a ServiceNow Configuration manager

As a Configuration Manager, you will be responsible for leading the governance, data quality, and ongoing development of our ServiceNow CMDB. You will collaborate closely with Process Owners, Product Management, Customer Service functions, and the ServiceNow Platform Owner to ensure that configuration data remains trustworthy, complete, and aligned with our platform strategy and ITSM practices.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is passionate about structure, accuracy, and continuous improvement — and who enjoys influencing how the organization manages technology information at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Own the Configuration Management process and ensure the health and quality of CMDB data.
  • Define, develop, and maintain CMDB governance policies, including CI class models, naming conventions, and lifecycle states.
  • Maintain and enhance the CMDB data model, structure, and CI relationships.
  • Ensure configuration data is accurate, complete, compliant, and supports ITSM processes.
  • Collaborate with Incident, Change, Problem, and other Process Owners to ensure correct usage of CI data.
  • Support stakeholders across the organization in product management and customer onboarding activities.
  • Lead CMDB audits and health checks, identifying gaps and driving corrective actions.
  • Define requirements for discovery, integrations, and data population into the CMDB.
  • Serve as the functional lead for CMDB-related tools and integrations in partnership with the ServiceNow Platform Owner.
  • Align configuration management practices with the overall ServiceNow platform strategy, architecture, and roadmap.

To rock this position, you own

  • Strong hands‑on experience with ServiceNow CMDB and configuration management practices.
  • Solid understanding of CMDB structure, CI relationships, lifecycle management , and data modelling.
  • Experience with running ITSM processes in ServiceNow .
  • Knowledge of ITIL and ITSM frameworks.
  • Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail and a drive for data quality.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross‑functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Ability to communicate complex information clearly across different teams.

Nice to have

  • ServiceNow certifications (e.g., CMDB, Discovery, ITOM).
  • Experience of ServiceNow integrations, and data ingestion methods.
  • Experience supporting product onboarding or customer onboarding service processes in ServiceNow.
  • Familiarity with audit and compliance activities related to configuration data.

What’s in it for you?

  • A role with significant ownership and impact on our ITSM and platform strategy
  • A collaborative environment partnering with skilled professionals across IT and business
  • Opportunities for growth within the ServiceNow and ITOM ecosystem
  • A chance to shape how the organization manages essential configuration and service data
  • We offer a dynamic and challenging work environment where you can grow your skills and advance your career. We are committed to fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and customer focus.
  • We offer you professional growth, open culture and an outstanding work‑life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working. Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle where you need to unlearn and relearn every day as new possibilities emerge.

About Industry Nexus

Nexus supports its customers in business process automation by exchanging and sharing business information with their business partners. We have two service areas: Business Information eXchange (BIX) and Multichannel.

Nexus has a large existing customer base in the Nordics and is a growing business unit within Tietoevry Industry. With a unique combination of global capabilities and local presence, Nexus currently serves more than 4000 customers in 50+ countries around the world - creating a digital advantage for millions every day.

Join us and make your mark!

We look forward to your application! Please attach your CV or LinkedIn‑profile and we’ll reach out to you. Interviews will be held on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply today.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact Heli Huuhtanen, Head of Customer Experience Hub, via e‑mail

Tieto creates purposeful technology that reinvents the world for good. We are a leading technology company with a strong Nordic heritage and global capabilities. Based on our core values of openness, trust and diversity, we work with our customers to develop digital futures where businesses, societies, and humanity thrive.

title: Senior Manager, Ocean Policy
description:
Senior Manager, Ocean Policy

Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position is open for consideration in the following locations in the Americas, with preference for candidates based in time zones that can accommodate calls with colleagues in Europe and Africa: Arlington-US, Brazil(remote), Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Guyana, Mexico, Suriname, Peru

Over the last 10 years, CI has developed a comprehensive Blue Climate program spanning over 20 countries dedicated to identifying and addressing science and policy priorities for oceans and climate globally. The Blue Climate program within the Center for Oceans at CI works closely with our field programs across the Americas, Asia-Pacific and Africa to design and implement innovative approaches to (1) implement nature-based climate adaptation solutions that improve coastal and marine communities’ livelihoods and resilience while also conserving ecosystems and biodiversity; and (2) conserve and restore coastal blue carbon ecosystems (mangroves, salt marshes, and seagrass meadows) for climate change mitigation. The Blue Climate program also has key leadership roles in advancing climate mitigation and adaptation priorities into national and regional coastal management and science through the International Blue Carbon Institute, Blue Carbon Initiative, the International Partnership for Blue Carbon, the Global Mangrove Alliance and the Global Green-Gray Community of Practice, and policy with the Center for Policy and Incentives.

Under the supervision of the Director, Ocean Policy, the Senior Manager, Ocean Policy, is a self-motivated, creative team member integral to the long-term growth and success of CI’s Blue Climate program and Ocean Policy team. The Senior Manager, Ocean Policy will support the development, implementation and management of strategic international policy‑based approaches and programs to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, climate mitigation, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon ecosystems and ocean‑climate integration. Together with the Director, Ocean Policy, they will work with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure alignment with CI’s larger international and national policy programs and priorities, including providing technical inputs and guidance on ocean‑climate issues. The position will also work closely with teams across CI including other programs within the Center for Oceans and the Moore Center for Science and Solutions to ensure alignment and integration of ocean policy priorities with all related CI programs and topic areas, including biodiversity, finance, and community fisheries.

RESPONSIBILITIES

International Ocean Policy

  • Manage strategic policy initiatives to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon, and other ocean‑climate areas which integrate and align international and national policy goals.
  • Work closely with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure ocean‑climate strategies and approaches are aligned with international and national policy programs and priorities.
  • Play a key role in project development, fundraising, implementation, communications, and broader capacity building for the Ocean Policy program.
  • Contribute to the drafting and revision of CI ocean policy positions, policy briefs, guidance documents, and other technical resources.
  • Play a key role in representing the Center for Oceans within the CI delegation to international policy meetings related to climate, biodiversity, and oceans, such as the UNFCCC climate COP and intersessional meetings. Additionally, support CI’s strategic engagement in these spaces (e.g., side events, meetings with countries and partners).
  • Support the development and management of relationships and partnerships with government representatives and like‑minded organizations to accelerate and achieve CI ocean policy objectives in close coordination with CI’s international policy team and relevant country programs.

Ocean Policy Advancement in Priority Countries

  • In partnership with CI country programs, the International Blue Carbon Institute, and the Center for Policy and Incentives, support the development and implementation of national or regional ocean policy objectives and programs which are aligned with and inform CI’s Blue Climate and broader policy priorities.
  • Provide CI programs and partners with strategic support, technical expertise, and/or capacity building for the integration of coastal ecosystems into Nationally Determined Contributions and implementation plans, national climate and ocean policy, greenhouse gas inventories, NBSAPs and other related components of ocean‑climate policy.
  • As needed, facilitate in‑person and virtual meetings, workshops, and related events with national governments and local partners to advance the priorities of CI country programs in alignment with national objectives.
  • Support the Ocean Policy Director in scoping new policy activities in accordance with existing CI programs.

Blue Climate Program

  • Contribute to strategy development, planning processes, fundraising, team initiatives/special projects, reporting and communication efforts as needed.
  • Coordinate with other teams across the Blue Climate network team to ensure programmatic alignment and synergies between CI projects.

Other duties as assigned by supervisor.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Frequent international travel (25% or more) is required.
  • Ability to work in remote locations or under difficult working conditions.
  • This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some days remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.
  • Requires working remotely with colleagues in other locations and time zones.
  • Flexible working hours: Frequent early morning and evening meetings, and occasional work over weekends, to accommodate colleagues in other time zones or high‑level policy events.
  • This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 5 to 7 years of experience working in international climate and/or ocean policy mechanisms and fora.
  • Understanding of government processes and the overall policy engagement environment.
  • Strong organization, project management, and prioritization skills.

About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next‑generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact. At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive‑level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey. Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e‑commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio. What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest‑growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

At Darkroom, you’ll step into a high‑impact role on a fast‑paced team that thrives at the intersection of creativity, strategy, and revenue. As a Client Success Manager , you’ll support a portfolio of accounts by building strong client relationships, keeping workstreams organized, and helping drive performance through clear communication, consistent execution, and thoughtful recommendations. This is an ideal opportunity for someone who is passionate about digital media and marketing, is motivated by performance, and thrives in an ambitious, high‑accountability environment. If you want to work closely with clients, learn from a world‑class team, and grow quickly while doing it, this is the role for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Build a strong understanding of Darkroom’s solutions suite and value proposition, using insights and data to support client retention and growth across your account portfolio.
  • Partner with Client Leadership and internal channel teams to understand client goals and help translate them into clear priorities and action plans.
  • Own day‑to‑day client communication: meeting notes, follow‑ups, timelines, and ensuring stakeholders remain aligned on deliverables and expectations.
  • Coordinate with cross‑functional teams (media, creative, strategy, analytics) to keep execution moving, remove blockers, and ensure high‑quality delivery.
  • Support strategic recommendations by organizing learnings, identifying opportunities, and helping prepare client‑facing guidance and next steps.
  • Assist in developing client deliverables including performance reporting, weekly/monthly updates, and MBR/QBR materials.
  • Maintain account hygiene and documentation: goals, risks, action items, and key decisions across accounts.

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A‑players that want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. A part of global technology organization Tieto,MentorMatecreates durable technical solutions that deliver digital transformation at scale by blending strategic insights and thoughtful design with brilliant engineering. With mature and established practices in enterprise web and mobiledevelopment, quality engineering, technical architecture, human-centered design, cloud, DevOps, data, and analytics, the company provides its people with the opportunity to work on impactful, global projects for recognizable brands.

We’re looking to hire a TechLeadAWS DevOps Engineer to help modernize and scale a global digital health SaaS platform used for data‑driven and AI-powered healthcare solutions. In this role, you’ll lead the evolution of the cloud, ML, and Kubernetes infrastructure - driving reliability, automation, cost efficiency, and operational excellence across mission‑critical workloads. You’ll work hands‑on with a modern AWS stack (Fargate, EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS), ML platforms (SageMaker, Kubeflow,MLflow), and CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD), enabling engineering and data science teams to deliver faster, safer, and at scale. As part of your leadership responsibilities, you will collaborate closely with mid‑level DevOps engineers, providing guidance, technical mentorship, and support. You’ll help shape best practices, uplift engineering maturity, and ensure the team grows both technically and operationally.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and enhance CI/CD pipelines supporting both application and ML deployment workflows
  • Lead operations for multi-tenant SaaS workloads on AWS, ensuring scalability, high availability, and cost efficiency
  • Build and maintain infrastructure automation using Infrastructure as Code(AWS CDK or Terraform)
  • Design, implement, and maintain reliable infrastructure for production, data, and AI/ML workloads
  • Own incident response, postmortems, and operational runbooks to improve system reliability and reduce MTTR
  • Enable self‑service capabilities for engineering and data science teams
  • Monitor and optimize cloud usage across compute, GPU, and storage resources, implementing cost controls and forecasting
  • Support and automate ML pipelines, including training, testing, and deployment using AWS SageMaker, Kubeflow, or MLflow
  • Manage GPU and compute clusters (EKS, ECS, EC2) for model training and inference workloads
  • Develop and maintain monitoring, alerting, observability, and security best practices
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Data, AI/ML, and PlatformOps teams to ensure smooth cross‑team delivery

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps/CloudOps/ SRE
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using AWS CDK
  • Advanced CI/CD pipeline expertise (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD), including build optimization, tuning, and troubleshooting
  • Hands‑on experience with Amazon EKS (Kubernetes operations, deployments, scaling, cluster configuration)
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, pipelines, runtime environments, observability, and incident management (Splunk, Grafana, OpenTelemetry)
  • Deep operational experience with AWS (Fargate, EKS, EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, CloudWatch, CloudTrail)
  • Familiarity with GPU workloads and performance/cost tuning for AI pipelines
  • Solid understanding of FinOps principles, cost monitoring, and right‑sizing in AWS
  • Strong collaboration, mentoring, and communication skills, with the ability to thrive in a fast‑paced, evolving environment
  • Excellent spoken and written English language skills

A Significant Advantage Would Be

  • Subject Matter Expert in one of the following: AWS, EKS, or IaC
  • Working experience with AI/ML platforms (AWS SageMaker, Kubeflow, MLflow, or equivalent)
  • Knowledge of MongoDB operations and performance optimization
  • Familiarity with Projen for automating CDK project configuration and management
  • Hands‑on experience with Helm charts and Kubernetes manifests
  • Awareness of regulatory compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, HIPAA)

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Gerente de Planejamento Comercial – Azzas 2154 – Rio de Janeiro

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Gerente de Planejamento Comercial e Merchan – SPRINT

Localização: Rio de Janeiro, RJ

I. Missão e Objetivo do Cargo

O Gerente de Planejamento Comercial e Merchan SPRINT é o guardião da viabilidade financeira e da otimização do produto. Sua missão é estruturar as operações de planejamento comercial, desde o zero, garantindo que a Visão de Produto Athleisure seja entregue com a máxima rentabilidade e eficiência de estoque no contexto de lançamento e crescimento rápido.

II. Principais Papéis e Responsabilidades

Este profissional irá capitanear o ciclo de vida do produto do ponto de vista financeiro e logístico.

1. Estrutura e Viabilidade de Compras (Sourcing & OTB)

Construção e Gestão do OTB (Open-to-Buy): Desenvolver, gerenciar e defender o orçamento de compras por coleção, categoria e canal, alinhado às metas financeiras agressivas da fase de lançamento.

Interface Estratégica com Sourcing: Trabalhar em estreita parceria com o Gerente de Produto (Estilo) e Sourcing para garantir que os tecidos técnicos e as inovações em performance sejam adquiridos com o melhor custo-benefício e prazo.

Projeção de Demanda: Garantir a acuracidade do forecast de vendas, considerando a performance histórica (como linha da Reserva) e a projeção para a marca SPRINT independente.

2. Planejamento de Produto e Coleção (Go-to-Market)

Definição de Sortimento Estratégico: Liderar a arquitetura da coleção (Mix de Produtos), definindo a pirâmide, o peso das categorias e a profundidade versus amplitude, com foco na assertividade do mix.

Análise de Performance Pós-Lançamento: Supervisionar a análise de dados para gerar insights acionáveis que otimizem as coleções em andamento e futuras.

Interface Multidisciplinar: Ser o principal ponto de contato entre Produto/Estilo, Logística e Comercial, assegurando o alinhamento de prazos e metas.

3. Gestão de Estoque e Ciclo de Vida (Merchandising)

Otimização de Estoque e Giro: Monitorar a cobertura, o giro e o sell-through, garantindo a máxima rentabilidade e minimizando o risco de dead stock.

Estratégia de Liquidação (Markdowns): Estruturar o plano tático de remarcações e ações promocionais, visando otimizar estoque com o menor impacto possível na margem bruta, essencial no início da marca.

Abastecimento Omnichannel: Definir a estratégia de distribuição inicial e o plano de reposição eficiente para canais digitais e futuras lojas e franquias.

4. Liderança e Desenvolvimento de Equipe

Construção de Equipe: Participar ativamente na contratação e no desenvolvimento inicial da equipe de Planejamento, Merchandising e Sourcing.

Gestão de Performance e KPIs: Ser o guardião dos indicadores de planejamento (Giro, Cobertura, Margem) e definir metas claras, promovendo o crescimento do time.

Requisitos e qualificações

Sólida trajetória em Planejamento Comercial, Merchandising ou Produto no Varejo de Moda (mandatório).

Experiência no segmento Sports/Athleisure será considerada um diferencial competitivo.

Expertise em OTB (Open-to-Buy): Domínio completo na construção, controle e gestão do orçamento de compras.

Gestão de KPIs e Ciclo de Vida: Visão analítica apurada sobre Giro, Cobertura, Sell-Through e GMROI. Capacidade de desenhar estratégias para todas as fases do produto, do lançamento à liquidação.

Excel Avançado: Capacidade de criar modelagens complexas e transformar grandes volumes de dados em modelos de decisão ágeis.

Gestão de Pessoas: Experiência comprovada na coordenação ou gerência de equipes, com foco em formação de times do zero e desenvolvimento de talentos.

Perfil estruturado e focado em construir processos escaláveis, com autonomia para atuar em um ambiente de ritmo acelerado (Sprint).

Liderança e Influência: Habilidade para transitar entre áreas parceiras (Produto e Comercial), inspirando o time e negociando prioridades em um cenário multidisciplinar.

Equilíbrio entre Criatividade e Finanças: Capacidade de garantir a viabilidade financeira (margem e custo) sem engessar a proposta estética e inovadora do Athleisure.

Comunicação Estratégica: Facilidade em traduzir métricas complexas em planos de ação claros e insights executivos para a diretoria.

Diferenciais (O que te destaca)

Visão Omnichannel: Experiência prática integrando o planejamento entre E-commerce e Varejo Físico.

Cultura Fast Fashion: Vivência em ambientes de alto giro que exigem reações rápidas às tendências de mercado.

Data Intelligence: Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Power BI ou Tableau) para automação de relatórios.

Formação Acadêmica: Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Varejo, Finanças ou Negócios.

  • 40% em graduação e pós-graduação em universidades conveniadas
  • 30% em curso de inglês conveniado
  • Descontos em produtos: 40% nas marcas Reserva / 30% nas marcas AZZAS

title: Supervisor de Logística
description:
Responsabilidades

  • Supervisiona e planeja a demanda diária de acordo com o cronograma de entregas estabelecido. Realiza um controle minucioso por meio do painel de visão detalhada, garantindo a execução de todas as etapas dos pedidos, que incluem separação, conferência, faturamento, transbordo, carregamento, roteirização, baixa adequada e registro correto dos motivos para eventuais falhas nas entregas;
  • Em situações de furo de estoque, acompanha atentamente a gestão do setor, envolvendo a consideração de oferecer produtos similares ou a confirmação da ruptura, visando assegurar que a expedição seja realizada na data de entrega acordada;
  • Garante o fluxo da demanda de retirada imediata do dia, identificando oportunidades para melhorar a produtividade e a qualidade. Também monitora os pedidos com prazos de retirada expirados, tomando as ações necessárias, como o contato com o cliente ou o cancelamento do pedido;
  • Mantém uma interação diária com a torre de controle e também reuniões mensais, avaliando as ocorrências e prestando suporte à equipe de administração logística, com acompanhamento atento do gestor;
  • Exerce supervisão sobre a equipe ADM, garantindo que todas as entregas programadas para o dia tenham Documento de Transporte (DT). Em casos de falta desse documento, atua diretamente junto à transportadora para garantir que o processo de roteirização seja concluído, assegurando que nosso indicador OTIF (On-Time In-Full) não seja prejudicado;
  • Utiliza o painel de roteirização para extrair informações relevantes que embasam suas decisões, antecipando-se a possíveis problemas apontados em ressalvas feitas pelos clientes e agilizando as soluções;
  • Busca constantemente maior agilidade e eficiência na resolução de casos de furo de estoque, aplicando análises cuidadosas e tomando decisões assertivas com relativa autonomia;
  • Identifica os gargalos operacionais e organiza a equipe de acordo com os picos de maior fluxo, assegurando que o tempo de separação dos pedidos e a permanência do cliente no local estejam alinhados com as diretrizes estabelecidas pela empresa;
  • Demonstra habilidade na análise de relatórios, propondo ações destinadas a aprimorar os processos existentes e alcançar os resultados almejados;
  • Contribui com o Gerente de Operações Logísticas, selecionando, contratando, animando, desenvolvendo e retendo conforme avaliação e necessidades do setor;
  • Atua na busca contínua por oportunidades de melhoria, antecipa-se a problemas, contribuindo com soluções adequadas;
  • Colabora com seu gestor na elaboração de relatórios voltados para o aumento da produtividade e o alcance dos objetivos do setor;
  • Torna-se uma referência para a equipe, compartilhando os números do setor e atingindo as metas estabelecidas;
  • Orienta os colaboradores da equipe para o plano diário de gestão, e supervisiona a realização das atividades. Acompanha o controle de estoque, incluindo endereçamentos, armazenamento de posições e realizações de inventários;
  • Assegura o bom uso e manutenção das ferramentas que estão à disposição da suas equipes (Cintas, Etiquetadoras, Coletores de dados, Empilhadeiras, Paleteiras, Rádios, Impressoras, Computadores, etc);
  • Garantir a eficácia de todos os processos relacionados à gestão de inventário, tanto rotativo quanto geral. Monitora a execução dos processos de movimentações, transitórios, endereçamento e negativos e promove a disseminação da cultura de endereçamento correto;
  • Assegura o cumprimento do procedimento de furo de estoque e mantem a vigilância constante sobre o monitoramento de deficiências de estoque no sistema e prepara relatórios semanais sobre o tema. Auxilia no processo de treinamento e desenvolvimento dos colaboradores (loja e logística) para uso dos recursos e aderência aos processos de movimentação e armazenagem de material;
  • Representa papel central na luta anti demarca e apresenta relatórios de maior profundidade durante as reuniões de briefing e, é um modelo de eficácia no contra poder e na adoção de boas práticas;
  • Orientar os colaboradores da equipe para o plano diário de operação, colaborar para a prevenção de perdas, zelar pela qualidade e conservação do estoque de mercadorias, zelar pelo o pátio logístico, direcionando sua equipe para mantê-lo sempre limpo e organizado;
  • Garante que todas as mercadorias sejam conferidas e estejam em perfeitas condições. monitorar a coleta das devoluções conforme acordos comerciais estabelecidos, orientando a equipe para melhor comunicação e seguimento dos processos;
  • Instrui a equipe a comunicar ao suporte de cadastros qualquer discrepância nos produtos cadastrados, como forma de prevenir erros no estoque. Desenvolve escala de trabalho, sempre verificando a necessidade operacional e normas legislativas;
  • Conduz a sua equipe na delimitação adequada dos espaços conforme o produto a ser recebido para otimizar o gerenciamento da conferência e da armazenagem, orienta os terceiros, responsáveis pela paletização, assegurando que esse processo seja realizado corretamente, seguindo os padrões definidos;
  • Garante o registro completo dos fretes FOB e certifica se todos foram pagos corretamente, efetuando o controle do pallets em débito com os fornecedores, garantindo a transparência nas relações comerciais e o cumprimento das obrigações;
  • Cria agendas de treinamentos para os demais setores, sobre o processo de devoluções via acordo comercial, visando instruí-los sobre o procedimento padrão de paletização e conferência, garantindo que todos sigam os protocolos estabelecidos.

  • Conhecimento em logística, produto, em sistemas de gerenciamento de armazém, legislação e regulação aplicados;
  • CNH (qualquer categoria);
  • Habilitação para operar empilhadeira, conforme modelo e requisitos do equipamento.

description:
General Manager - This is a rare opportunity to lead a strategic operation in one of the most relevant energy markets globally. The selected executive will have direct impact on corporate results, access to global expertise, and the mandate to build a legacy of growth and operational excellence.

General Manager

The Opportunity

We are seeking a transformational General Manager to lead and expand a well-established operation within the energy services sector in Brazil.

This is not a maintenance role. This is a growth mandate.

The selected executive will take full ownership of the country P&L, drive operational excellence, strengthen culture, and lead the next phase of strategic expansion. The goal is clear: double revenue within three years while maintaining uncompromising safety and performance standards.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic & Business Leadership

  • Full P&L responsibility for the country operation.
  • Develop and execute a robust business plan to ensure sustainable growth, profitability, and market share expansion.
  • Continuously assess market dynamics, competitive landscape, and client needs to identify new business opportunities.
  • Act as the senior representative of the company with key clients, partners, regulators, and industry stakeholders.

Operational Excellence

  • Lead the HSE culture aligned with the highest industry standards.
  • Oversee multi-site operations, ensuring projects are delivered on time, on budget, and with operational excellence.
  • Implement global best practices adapted to local realities.
  • Drive process optimization, cost efficiency, and continuous innovation.
  • Develop and mentor high-performing teams.
  • Build a strong leadership pipeline and succession planning structure.
  • Strengthen a culture rooted in accountability, collaboration, and high performance.
  • Ensure transparent and strategic communication across all organizational levels.

Strategic Objectives

  • Double revenue within 3 years.
  • Expand market share through new contracts and strategic positioning.
  • Achieve operational excellence with a zero-incident mindset.
  • Strengthen regional leadership presence and stakeholder relationships.
  • Maximize the performance and development of the team.

Required Experience

  • 15+ years of experience in the Oil & Gas sector.
  • Proven track record in senior leadership roles with direct P&L ownership.
  • Experience managing complex, multidisciplinary teams in demanding environments.

Technical Expertise

  • Strong and proven experience in Oil & Gas Services

Education & Languages

  • Degree in Engineering (Petroleum, Mechanical, or related), Geosciences, Business Administration, or similar.
  • MBA or Executive Education is a strong plus.
  • Full fluency in English is mandatory (daily interaction with global stakeholders).
  • Portuguese fluency required not nationality.

Leadership Profile

  • Strategic mindset with strong execution capability.
  • Commercial acumen and long-term vision.
  • Decisive leadership in ambiguous environments.
  • Inspirational leadership style with strong people development focus.
  • Ability to build strategic alliances in a matrix organization.
  • Results orientation with hands‑on attitude.
  • Resilience under pressure.
  • Uncompromising integrity and ethical standards.

Compensation

  • Highly competitive executive package including fixed monthly compensation aligned with senior market standards.
  • Short‑Term Incentive (STI).
  • Long‑Term Incentive (LTI) including equity participation.

description:
Descrição da vaga

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Realizar entrevistas detalhadas com familiares para levantamento do histórico do desenvolvimento.

title: Cost Analyst
description:
Advert Intermoor, Acteon’s Moorings and Anchors business line, provides project and operational management expertise to customers across the mooring lifecycle. By combining operational knowledge of mooring equipment, anchor handling and industry failure modes with subsea engineering expertise, we create a company unmatched within the mooring niche. This approach mitigates risks in delivery, installation and operations across the lifecycle, reducing mooring lifecycle costs and safeguarding major operations that protect start‑up schedules when mooring and mooring intervention are on the project or production critical path.

InterMoor is looking to add a Cost Analyst to the team. The Cost Analyst will manage and analyze costs to ensure financial efficiency and adherence to budgets.

The successful candidate will be based in the Rio de Janeiro area.

Important

Please submit Resumes/CVs in English.

Duties

  • Monitoring and updating cost estimates for projects to ensure they are within expected ranges
  • Coordinating with other departments such as human resources, payroll, accounting, and finance to ensure that all costs are accurately tracked
  • Conducting cost analyses to identify areas where costs can be reduced or eliminated altogether
  • Monitoring budgets to ensure that spending does not exceed approved levels
  • Preparing reports to management regarding costs and expenses
  • Preparing bid estimates for new projects or bids on existing projects
  • Managing supplier relationships to ensure that the company is receiving quality products at competitive prices
  • Support month‑end processes, coordinate month‑end accruals to the Finance Department

Required

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • Minimum 3 years' experience working in cost control
  • Competency in Total Cost Management
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel (or a Cost Control tool)
  • Fluent in English
  • Proficient in Earned Value Management

description:
Job Description

Do you have a strong background in quality assurance, a structured approach to testing, and want to join one of the largest technology companies in the Nordics? Then this is the role for you.

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer who wants to be part of Tieto Tech Consulting . Tieto Tech Consulting works as a true partner, solving clients’ toughest technology challenges and delivering reliable outcomes that drive measurable results. By combining engineering excellence with disciplined quality practices, we support customers developing and operating critical digital platforms.

In this role, you will work in close collaboration with product, engineering, and design teams, ensuring high quality, reliability, and scalability of backend services in a modern cloud-based environment.

When joining Tieto Tech Consulting as a Quality Assurance Engineer, you will

  • Partner with product, engineering, and design teams to refine user stories, ensuring acceptance criteria are clear, complete, and testable.
  • Conduct daily evaluations of the QA swimlane in JIRA for new feature work and collaborate with engineers to execute test cycles.
  • Design, develop, and document comprehensive test plans and test cases for new and existing backend services.
  • Develop and maintain Postman API tests and automated integration test suites targeting backend services and data flows across AWS components (SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, EventBridge).
  • Implement and manage API contract testing to validate integrations and ensure data consistency across internal and external services.
  • Design, execute, and maintain performance, load, and stress tests for critical backend infrastructure to ensure scalability and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to define and test security, access control, and compliance requirements (e.g. HIPAA) for backend services handling sensitive data.
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) to establish continuous quality gates and support safe, frequent deployments.
  • Manage initial release completion, acting as the first quality gate by approving tickets when testing passes or returning them for rework when defects are identified.
  • Collaborate with QA Engineers across squads to ensure a consistent and high-quality experience for both patient- and provider-facing features.

Who we are looking for

  • Experienced QA professional with 5+ years of experience in startup or fast-paced environments, combining strong manual testing skills with automated testing capabilities.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience testing AWS-based backend architectures using Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of testing patterns for distributed systems and AWS services such as SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, and EventBridge .
  • Proficiency in a modern programming language such as Python, Java, or TypeScript for writing and maintaining automated test suites.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing automated integration, end-to-end, and component tests .
  • Experience with performance, load, and stress testing applied to backend infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with API contract testing frameworks .
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD principles and experience integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines.
  • Familiarity with agile development practices and bug tracking tools (e.g. JIRA, BrowserStack ).
  • Strong analytical mindset with a continuous improvement approach.
  • Detail-oriented in test execution and thorough in documentation.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.

Experience in the healthcare domain is considered an advantage.

As a person, you are a team player who takes responsibility for quality, works in a structured and disciplined manner, and communicates clearly. You value accuracy, reliability, and continuous improvement in everything you do.

We offer

We offer professional growth, meaningful projects, an open culture, and a strong work-life balance. You will have the opportunity to work in a growing and future-oriented sector, contributing to high-impact digital solutions. We provide a hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working, and we believe in curiosity and continuous learning as technology evolves.

Location

Asunción, Paraguay (Hybrid)

We perform background checks on all final candidates. Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Communicate information to appropriate parties and work closely with the Project group and MFT to provide the best possible answer to tenders.

Uma história de mais de 60 anos de solidez e inovação.

Em 1961 foi fundado o Banco Sofisa, em uma jornada de transformação, adaptação e principalmente inovação.

Hoje, temos orgulho em ser um dos principais bancos do Brasil. O motivo disso é incentivar e acreditar no empreendedor brasileiro, fortalecendo relacionamentos apoiados na ética e no respeito. Um dos fatores que nos destacam no mercado é o comprometimento dos nossos colaboradores, com forte espírito empreendedor e uma paixão que os fazem vestir a camisa como se fossem donos. É essa mesma motivação que nos leva a prêmios e conquistas notáveis, como o de Melhor Banco do Brasil, em um ranking realizado pela Forbes, no ano de 2023.

Por aqui, não nos contentamos com o status quo. Acreditamos que sempre podemos melhorar, aprender, investir e buscar o novo. A melhora contínua é um processo diário. Em 2011, inauguramos uma nova categoria de serviços bancários no Brasil, lançando o primeiro banco digital de investimentos: o Sofisa Direto. Com isso, encontramos a oportunidade ideal para manter os nossos clientes motivados a buscar os seus objetivos. Em toda a história, os negócios do Banco Sofisa foram construídos por uma sólida estrutura financeira, assegurada por altos índices de capitalização, fazendo com que os nossos clientes sintam-se seguros, investindo em ativos de qualidade, que muitas das vezes só se encontram por aqui.

Hoje, podemos dizer que vencemos o maior de todos os testes, o teste do tempo. E se esse teste foi vencido, é porque valorizamos quem realmente importa: você, nosso cliente. Cada obstáculo superado, cada desafio vencido são os fundamentos da solidez e a experiência que precisamos para seguir em frente.
