title: Gerente de Qualidade, Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento (P&D)
description:
Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Qualidade, Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento (PD) para garantir a excelência e a conformidade dos produtos, atuando como barreira crítica de segurança da produção . Essa posição assegura que somente itens dentro de especificação avancem no processo, com rastreabilidade, evidências e registros completos , liderando a rotina do Controle de Qualidade Laboratorial e apoiando melhorias técnicas e frentes de PD.

Na prática, sua rotina costuma ser assim:

  • Inspeção de recebimento: garantir a execução de testes físico-químicos em matéria-prima e embalagens, com emissão de laudo de aprovação ou laudo de rejeição antes do descarregamento.
  • Liberação de linha e lote: coordenar coletas e análises durante o processo produtivo, assegurando a liberação documentada de cada lote produzido.
  • Bloqueio de não conformidade: identificar desvios em tempo real e executar bloqueio imediato da linha ou do lote, com registro fotográfico e sistêmico, acionando a liderança de operações.
  • Controle de retenção: organizar e catalogar o banco de amostras de retenção diária, garantindo 100% de cobertura por lote e fácil localização para rastreabilidade.
  • Gestão de equipamentos: assegurar rotina de calibração e limpeza dos equipamentos do laboratório, com checklist de aferição registrado no início de cada turno.
  • Gestão da rotina de Qualidade e PD: direcionar prioridades, garantir cumprimento de procedimentos, disciplina de registros/evidências e suporte técnico às necessidades do processo/produto.
  • Documentação e padrões: apoiar manutenção/atualização de POPs, formulários e registros do laboratório, garantindo conformidade e rastreabilidade.
  • Segurança e 5S: reforçar práticas de EPI, manuseio, descarte e organização do laboratório.

Requisitos

  • Formação técnica ou superior em Química ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em Controle de Qualidade Laboratorial (rotina, liberação, rastreabilidade e registros).
  • Perfil de liderança para tomada de decisão e postura firme em bloqueios e tratativas.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência com tratativas de não conformidade e investigação de desvios (ex.: OOS/OOT).
  • Experiência com estruturação de padrões, checklists e rotina de evidências/registros.
  • Atuação com melhorias de processo e suporte técnico a iniciativas de desenvolvimento (PD).

title: Technical Process Support Engineer
description:
About The Role

We are looking for a Technical Process Support Engineer with a strong commercial mindset and solid process engineering experience within the oil and gas industry.

This role combines topside process engineering expertise with the ability to identify optimization opportunities, assess production assets, and translate technical diagnostics into value-generating business solutions for clients.

The professional will evaluate onshore and offshore production units, conduct technical audits, identify operational bottlenecks, and propose innovative, economically viable solutions focused on asset optimization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct technical and operational audits of oil and gas production assets.
  • Assess process performance, identify bottlenecks, and uncover optimization opportunities.
  • Perform independent process diagnostics on onshore and offshore units (FPSOs, fixed platforms, and onshore facilities).
  • Translate technical findings into structured value propositions and improvement initiatives.
  • Develop optimization roadmaps focused on operational efficiency and economic return.
  • Support aftermarket services, brownfield projects, and topside modifications.
  • Interface directly with Operations, Engineering teams, suppliers, and clients to gain firsthand familiarity of customer needs plus product applications.
  • Provide technical support during commissioning, start‑up, ramp‑up, and operational phases (desirable).
  • Provides qualified technical sales support to sales team for marketing and sales activities, and to Operations for technical support as required.
  • Evaluate customer support issues as well as maintain top level positive perception by customers pertinent to organization support structure.
  • Prepare technical samples, designs along with presentations to provide supportive technical data as per customer needs.
  • Participate in sales support related conferences, trade shows, workshops plus meetings to update on current information plus developments in industry.

Minimum Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or related disciplines.

Experience

  • Proven experience as a Process Engineer within the oil and gas industry.
  • Experience working onboard offshore units and/or onshore production facilities.
  • Background in process audits, performance evaluation, and operational efficiency analysis.

Core Technical Knowledge

  • Oil, gas, and water separation systems.
  • Strong expertise in managing gas production operations and processes: topside, refining, downstrime, production platforms.
  • Gas treatment systems (H₂S/CO₂ removal via amine or membrane systems, dehydration, compression).
  • Produced water treatment systems.
  • Heat exchangers, pressure vessels, filtration systems, and utilities.
  • Familiarity with amine systems, membranes, fixed‑bed scavengers, and hybrid process configurations.
  • Experience in aftermarket services and brownfield environments.
  • Knowledge of oil and gas industry standards (API, ASME, NORSOK – desirable).
  • Strong interest in commercial activity, sales, and expanding business opportunities.
  • Process Simulation Software Expertise: Aspen HYSYS

Languages

  • Advanced English (mandatory).
  • Fluent Portuguese (mandatory).

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  • Backend : Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  • Data : Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend : Building the "Control Room" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps : Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together, ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s "Visualizations" and that the "Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration : You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards : Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The "Expert" : When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership : Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

Qualifications

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have

  • Streaming : Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • Graph : Hands‑on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies.
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy‑focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities / The Technology Stack

  • Backend : Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend : Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data : Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure : Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud.

Desired Profile

  • The Architect‑Implementer : You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot : You are likely a Backend or Full‑Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset : You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

title: Incident Investigator - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview

We are seeking an Industrial Incident Investigator to join Loss Prevention Organization (LP)

LP is responsible for providing both day-to-day in-field occupational and process safety support to Saudi Aramco operations, as well as centralized technical support and consulting function. Our field offices are located in Abqaiq, Riyadh, Ras Tanura, Dhahran, Udhailiyah, Jeddah (including Yanbu and Jazan), and Tanajib. Through these offices, LP provides its services to all Saudi Aramco facilities and departments that are located throughout the Kingdom.

Your primary role is to help investigate industrial incidents (fires, major leaks, hydrocarbon explosions, etc.), identify proper root causes, and the actions necessary to prevent recurrence. This includes preparing draft and final incident reports, as well as providing long term support to address all recommendations.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Investigate industrial incidents, especially ones with high consequences and understand the hazards related to industrial facilities and their relevant controls.
  • Identify, preserve, and examine incident evidence using widely accepted forensic science principles.
  • Support investigation teams by ensuring proper investigation techniques are understood and used.
  • Conduct through investigations using appropriate investigative tools for the incident in question. Understand incident causation and impact of human factors.
  • Develop and/or thoroughly review all draft incident investigation reports and complete all stages of review.
  • Identify recommendations that should be shared globally for corporate wide implementation.
  • Develop lessons learned and safety alerts/bulletins to communicate actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Educate employees, contractors, and others, to ensure timely communication of lessons learned.
  • Develop and review corporate safety guidance on incident investigations.
  • You will hold a Bachelor degree in Engineering or Engineering Technology from an Accredited Institution,
  • You will have 10 years of experience investigating high consequence (major) industrial incidents, as well as a deep understanding of the various tools and techniques currently utilized to conduct such investigations.
  • You will have an excellent ability to communicate in English with peers as well as members of management, and be able to produce clear and concise oral and written reports in English.

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

title: F&B Concessions Coordinator
description:
Department

Tournament and Venue Operations

Location

Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

Working alongside the FIFA/FIFA27 Partnership Rights Delivery (PRD) team and reporting to the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager in Zurich and the FIFA27 Senior F&B Concessions Manager, the F&B Concessions Coordinator supports the operational planning and delivery of the Public Food and Beverage (F&B) Concessions Programme for stadium spectators and fulfillment of FIFA’s Commercial Partners’ contractual rights and obligations across all stadiums at the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. The objective is to implement and deliver successfully the FIFA Commercial Partners’ exclusive food & beverage rights. This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful tournament through the delivery of FIFA’s commercial operations in the host country. The role operates under the supervision of the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager and the FIFA27 Senior F&B Concessions Manager and does not carry direct commercial ownership or decision‑making authority over F&B concessionaire or Commercial Partner agreements.

Key Responsibilities

  • The main responsibilities of the F&B Concessions Coordinator for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ encompass supporting the planning, coordination, and operational delivery of the F&B Concessions Programme, including but not limited to:
  • Support the implementation of the Public F&B Concessions Programme across all eight stadiums, including timeline tracking, milestone follow‑up, and coordination of deliverables.
  • Assist in integrating Commercial Partner products and services within the F&B Concessions Programme.
  • Support the planning and operational implementation of the commercial rights granted to FIFA’s Commercial Partners within the F&B Concessions Programme.
  • Coordinate with appointed F&B Concessionaire(s), service providers, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth information flow and execution of services within the F&B Concessions project.
  • Provide administrative and organisational support throughout the F&B concessionaire tender (RFP) and other related F&B related tender processes, including documentation management, evaluation support, reporting and assistance in market research activities.
  • Support the review, mapping, preparation, and optimisation of onsite F&B infrastructure and facilities across all official stadiums, ensuring proper documentation and tracking of action points.
  • Track the development and implementation of F&B concepts and operations, menus, pricing, and onsite infrastructure across all stadiums, ensuring deadlines and requirements are met.
  • Coordinate logistics and administrative preparation for stadium inspections and Commercial Partner operational F&B site visits, preparing documentation and follow‑up actions.
  • Support the creation and coordination of F&B-related signage and branding elements (e.g. menu boards).
  • Assist in defining and optimising the service and display of F&B Commercial Partners’ products, supporting alignment between internal and external stakeholders.
  • Prepare reports, presentations, dashboards, and tracking tools using Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, etc.).
  • Assist in developing and maintaining training materials, briefing documents, presentations and operational guidelines.
  • Assist with monitoring daily operations pre‑tournament and during tournament time, ensuring proper documentation and reporting.

Your Profile

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Catering, Hospitality Management, Event Management, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent level of education).

Experience

  • 2 - 4 years of professional experience in food & beverage, catering, hospitality, event management, or a related area.
  • Experience supporting F&B concessions or catering operations, ideally within large‑scale international events, preferably in the sports industry.
  • Exposure to project coordination and administrative support within complex, multi‑stakeholder environments.
  • Experience assisting in infrastructure or operational planning is considered an asset.

Skills & Competencies

  • Good understanding of the food & beverage concessions industry; experience in stadium or event environments is an advantage.
  • Basic knowledge of utilities and infrastructure requirements relevant to F&B operations (e.g. electricity, water supply).
  • Understanding of food safety and hygiene standards applicable to F&B operations.
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
  • Structured working style with high attention to detail and strong follow‑up capabilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and under tight timelines.
  • Proactive and solution‑oriented mindset with a service‑focused approach to commercial rights delivery.

Certification & Requirements

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams; knowledge of Visio and MS Project is an advantage).
  • Experience using planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • Willingness to travel and work extended hours during peak project phases and tournament time.

Candidate Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual – Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro for the duration of the employment (pre‑tournament and operational tournament time).

Technology

Brazil

Reporting organisationally to the Head of Technology Operations, the Technology Contract Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Technology team, and work in close collaboration with the Technology teams based in Brazil and other key individuals responsible for overseeing the relationship, performance, and contract management of our strategic technology partners and suppliers. Drawing on your experience as part of significant sporting event, you will contribute to the success of this global spectacle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Overseeing a diverse portfolio of technology contracts, ensuring adherence to contractual obligations and performance standards.
  • Developing and implementing a robust contract management strategy to streamline processes and enhance overall efficiency.
  • Support the management of relationships across a large base of technology vendors and suppliers to foster collaboration and address any issues promptly.

  • Manage the governance and controls framework, in collaboration with project leads / SMEs.
  • Proactively manage risks and issues within technology and change related to contract and performance management.
  • Apply expertise in reporting financial spend (using tools such as Power BI, SAP, etc.) related to contracts, invoices etc.
  • Lead and oversee tender processes, including initiating and executing technology purchase requisitions via SAP in accordance with procurement guidelines.
  • Coordinate multi-supplier/partner collaborations and contribute to decisions on supplier proposals to continually enhance services, including the development of an evaluation process.
  • Document management of all tender documents, contracts, and invoices in accordance with the storage management requirements.
  • Responsible for ensuring the execution of contracts follow the appropriate workflows via DocuSign.

Your Profile

Education

  • University degree or equivalent high education.

Qualification

  • Proven track record in managing and implementing Governance Processes.
  • Extensive experience in running KPI/SLA driven engagement.
  • Significant commercial and contract management experience.
  • Proven track record in leading procurements.
  • Strong understanding of suppliers and contract management.
  • Industry knowledge and experience or understanding of the structure and organization of utilities and their core activities.
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation.
  • Strong political acumen and adaptable to a wide range of working environments.

Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years overall technology contract management experience and minimum 2 years of experience in a similar role
  • Experience in the sports / major event industry
  • Proven track record of managing complex and high spend technology contracts across tier one telecoms and network providers

Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent teamwork and leadership skills
  • Excellent written, verbal, and active listening communication skills
  • Excellent organizational and time management skillsConflict resolution skills are a must.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority.
  • Proven ability to manage teams remotely.
  • Sharp analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High sense of accountability, trustworthiness, and ethics.
  • Customer and results oriented.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Fluent in English
  • Native or Fluent in Portuguese
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools

The Department of Radiology in the College of Medicine at Howard University invites applications for a full-time, tenure-track assistant or associate position with research expertise and teaching interests in advancing mathematics-enhanced artificial intelligence (AI) for radiology and imaging sciences. With an anticipated start date of August 2026, this position is part of the Office of the Provost Artificial Intelligence (AI) Cluster Hire Initiative, which aims to expand AI interdisciplinary research and instruction across the university. This cluster hiring aims to recruit scholars with expertise in the interdisciplinary fields of biomedical imaging, artificial intelligence, and data science. While the Department of Radiology welcomes applicants whose work intersects biology, medicine, or other data-intensive fields, applicants should be scholars who are broadly interested in research that addresses significant scientific or societal challenges through advanced biomedical approaches.

Supervisory Authority

The candidate will supervise postdocs, students, research assistants or lab interns conducting projects.

Nature And Scope

This position is part of the cluster, "Advancing Health through Mathematics Enhanced AI for Radiology and Endocrinology," which is jointly led by the College of Arts and Sciences and the College of Medicine. The goal is to bring together and invest in faculty across departments whose research and scholarship are linked through this cluster and to attract faculty members who can bring different perspectives.

The successful applicant is expected to contribute to an interdisciplinary academic environment through research, teaching, mentorship, and collaboration. Primary responsibilities include leading independent and collaborative research initiatives, applying AI and advanced imaging techniques to biomedical challenges, and participating in student training and curriculum development. The position emphasizes research that addresses health disparities and fosters inclusive excellence.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Leverage Howard University's distinctive resources and datasets to address health disparities impacting historically underserved communities, with an emphasis on leveraging Artificial Intelligence technologies to improve diagnostic, treatment, and prevention strategies for diseases disproportionately affecting these populations.
  • Conduct research across various imaging science fields using disease animal models, including brain injury, neurological diseases, developmental disorders, diabetes, and nanomedicine. Utilize MRI/MRS, PET/CT, and other imaging modalities, incorporating Artificial Intelligence techniques to advance both preclinical and clinical applications.
  • Coordinate research collaborations between the imaging facilities in the Molecular Imaging Laboratory at Howard University. Provide expertise in imaging methods and experimental design from small animal imaging to translational-clinical imaging studies.
  • Organize training sessions and workshops for researchers interested in using the MRI.
  • Participates in academic, didactic, and professional training provided through seminars, workshops and direct meetings with grant faculty.
  • Conducts data collection, statistical analysis, and data interpretation responsibilities related to the Molecular Imaging Laboratory grant portfolio.

Core Competencies

  • Expertise in advanced biomedical imaging modalities (MRI, PET, CT, microscopy) and experience integrating AI techniques into imaging workflows (preferred).
  • Proficiency in programming and operating systems such as Bruker MRI and microPET/CT systems (preferred).
  • Demonstrated experience with machine learning and deep learning frameworks.
  • Strong foundation in statistical analysis, data visualization, and computational modeling.
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively in interdisciplinary research environments.
  • Effective communication and organizational skills; strong written and oral proficiency in English.

Minimum Requirements

  • PhD in Radiological Sciences, Physical Sciences, Chemistry, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, or a closely related field.
  • Demonstrated experience in biomedical imaging and AI applications.

title: Onboarding Manager - Publishers (Remote)
description:
About MonetizeMore

MonetizeMore is a global leader in ad tech, seen by 300M+ people monthly. For 16 years, we’ve achieved double-digit growth by blending proprietary AI technology with manual optimization techniques to empower publishers. We are a culture-centric, location-independent organization that values Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen, and Collaboration.

MonetizeMore offers location and schedule freedom to every one of its team members. That means that you would have the lifestyle autonomy to choose to work from anywhere in the world, during the time of day you prefer. This new-age work lifestyle would enable you to engineer your ideal lifestyle. Say goodbye to endless commutes, stuffy business attire, and the arbitrary 9 to 5 work-day. Take your life back into your hands by joining the MonetizeMore team!

What You’ll Do

As part of our Publisher Centric Team , At M2, we focus and emphasize proactive Publisher Services. As the Onboarding Manager, your role is a critical "first impression" of our organization and our ability to support our publishing partners in reaching their goals.

You will spearhead the onboarding process for new publishers, ensuring they are equipped with the right tech, knowledge, and confidence to succeed. You are not just setting up accounts you are orchestrating a "White Glove" experience that reduces time-to-value and sets the stage for long-term retention. You also pay attention to improving our systems and processes along the way to continuously improve our service to publishers.

Responsibilities

  1. Project Management & Implementation
    • Lead the Lifecycle: Expertly manage the publisher journey from Sales endorsement to "Live" status. You are the project manager for the publisher’s first 30-90 days.
    • Technical Coordination: Collaborate with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers to troubleshoot setup concerns (Header Bidding, GAM, wrappers) and ensure optimal configuration.
    • Feature Activation: Ensure all applicable M2 Tech Features are activated at launch to maximize publisher revenue immediately (KPI: Uptake %).
  2. Client-Centric Communication & Education
    • Kick-off & Strategy: Conduct kick-off calls to understand the publisher's specific business goals and align our implementation plan to meet them.
    • Ambassadorship: Act as the primary champion for M2 tools and products. Provide comprehensive walkthroughs to ensure publishers are comfortable and proficient with our platform.
    • Responsive Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for all questions during installation, providing guidance that is both technical and empathetic.
  3. Performance Analysis & Handoff
    • Performance Reviews: Conduct thorough 7-day and 30-day post-live performance reviews. Use data to demonstrate value and identify early optimization wins.
    • Seamless Transition: Manage a structured handoff to the Ad Optimizer and Customer Success Manager, ensuring no momentum is lost after the initial 30-day period.

Day-today Activities

You are the external face of MonetizeMore for our newest partners. You thrive on variety and high-energy interaction—no two days (or publishers) are exactly alike.

  • External Engagement: You will constantly meet new partners, leading high-impact kickoff calls to align our tech with their specific business goals.
  • Project Command: You project manage the entire implementation lifecycle, coordinating between the publisher and our technical teams to ensure an optimal, revenue-ready setup and accelerated scale.
  • Performance Ownership: You don't just "set it and forget it." You conduct data-driven 7-day and 30-day etc. performance reviews to prove value immediately.
  • Seamless Handoff: Once the foundation is solid, you orchestrate a smooth transfer to the account management team ensuring the relationship momentum continues uninterrupted.

How this role fits into the organization

This is a cornerstone role that is pivotal to our company’s success.

  • Strategic Impact: Reporting to the Ad Ops Team Manager, you are the architect of the "First 30 Days." Since our publishers' growth is our growth, our long-term revenue goals effectively start on your desk.
  • The "Wow" Factor: You are responsible for delivering the "White Glove" experience. You set the trajectory for retention by uncovering publisher goals early and proving that MonetizeMore is a partner, not just a vendor.
  • Bridge Builder: You act as the vital link between Sales promises and long-term Operational success, ensuring that every new client enters our ecosystem with clarity, confidence, and a setup primed for revenue generation.

Who You Are

Must Haves

  • Experience: 1+ years of experience in Programmatic sell-side advertising, Customer Onboarding, or Ad Operations.
  • Technical Knowledge: Understanding of Google Ad Manager (GAM), AdSense, Header Bidding, and Google Analytics. Experience with WordPress and debugging ad calls is a strong plus.
  • Analytical Skills: Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and data presentation tools. You can spot trends in numbers quickly.
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You can command a room (virtually) and manage expectations clearly.
  • Project Management: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple implementations simultaneously without dropping the ball.

Nice to Have

  • Has worked with AdSense, Google Analytics, and GAM and has extensive knowledge of Google policies and other platforms
  • Understands coding and has a strong tech background
  • Has worked with WordPress and is knowledgeable when it comes to implementing ads and debugging ad calls
  • Bilingual - Portuguese and Spanish are an extra bonus

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary : Our salary formula adjusts to your cost of living and experience.
  • Work remotely : Live and work wherever you like!
  • Flexible working hours : You have the autonomy to set your own schedule
  • Retreats : We meet in person for company get-togethers.
  • Career growth and learning opportunities

If you think you are a good fit to join our Ad Optimization , please apply on this side bar and give specific reasons what sets you apart. We hire individuals, not robots so don’t be afraid to show a little personality.

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion. Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

description:
CapsLock Amazonas Candidatar-se CapsLock builds exceptional IT marketing solutions for large partners from North America. We don’t just advertise our clients’ products or services — we build long-term marketing solutions within the context of enduring partnerships.

Our people’s diversity and their ideas inspire the innovation that runs through everything we do, from unique technology to industry-leading services and customer experiences. We believe teams that openly support and challenge each other are destined to win.

Role Overview

Our QA department is scaling — and we’re looking for a QA Team Lead who can combine strong technical leadership in Playwright with strategic management and team development.

Your mission

Will be to ensure high-quality, stable, and predictable delivery of landing page projects by leading the QA team, setting Playwright standards, and developing a sustainable test automation strategy that supports rapid releases. This role suits someone who thrives in a fast-changing environment, enjoys solving complex testing challenges, and knows how to build systems that scale.

Your Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

  • Own and evolve the Playwright-based test architecture – ensuring stability, maintainability, and efficient execution.
  • Define and enforce coding standards, structure, and testing conventions across all automated projects.
  • Conduct code reviews, share best practices, and drive technical quality within the automation domain.
  • Collaborate with manual QA engineers to translate checklists and test cases into automated coverage where applicable.
  • Monitor and analyze automation results, identify weak spots, and continuously improve test reliability.
  • Align with DevOps to maintain visibility of automation runs and ensure seamless CI/CD reporting (Bitbucket Pipelines, Allure).
  • Explore and propose new tools or approaches when relevant, that could improve testing speed, maintainability, or team efficiency.

Team Management

  • Lead and support a small QA team (Manual QA + Automation QA), ensuring clear goals, priorities, and accountability.
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, track performance and motivation, and provide constructive feedback.
  • Plan sprint testing activities, manage workload distribution, and monitor delivery quality.
  • Encourage initiative and continuous learning within the team — fostering ownership and collaboration.
  • Align with the QA Department Lead and Design Director to ensure consistent quality standards and smooth communication across teams.

Process & Quality Ownership

  • Oversee end-to-end testing processes — from planning and documentation to execution and reporting.
  • Maintain and improve manual and automated test documentation, ensuring accuracy and clarity.
  • Review and validate bug reports, test cases, and coverage consistency across projects.
  • Define and maintain meaningful QA metrics — starting with automation coverage — and introduce additional measurements that help assess testing effectiveness, stability, and release quality.
  • Continuously improve workflows to make testing faster, more transparent, and better aligned with release cycles.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in QA, including at least 3 years in test automation.
  • 2+ years of experience leading QA engineers or automation teams, owning team performance, processes, and technical direction.
  • Deep expertise in Playwright (TypeScript) — designing test architecture, writing clean code, and ensuring scalability.
  • Practical experience building and maintaining automation frameworks for fast-changing web projects.
  • Experience running and maintaining automation in CI/CD environments (Bitbucket Pipelines, Allure, or similar tools).
  • Strong communication and leadership skills — able to connect technical decisions with business priorities and team goals.
  • English: B2 or higher.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building or improving QA automation strategy for web products.
  • Practical experience with visual testing (Playwright snapshots, Percy, Applitools) and using consistent test data setups.
  • Experience expanding or maintaining automation across multiple projects or environments.
  • Ability to design clear QA reports and metrics that help track quality and team progress.
  • Curiosity about AI-assisted testing or new ways to make automation faster and smarter.
  • Desire to build a strong technical culture within the QA team — share knowledge, improve standards, and support others’ growth.
  • Understanding of core QA principles and structured testing (ISTQB-level knowledge is a plus).

description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Data Management Analyst to join Reliability & Asset Management Division.

The Reliability & Asset Management Division is responsible for monitoring and Diagnosing High Voltage assets that are operated or maintained by Power Systems. This function is targeting increase in power supply reliably and improvement in overall efficiently.

Your primary role is to perform all data management activities for a particular business area, ensure compliance with relevant laws and regulations, implement data management initiatives, support adoption of corporate data standards and guideline, and improve data quality.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Assist in performing data stewardship responsibilities which include ensuring compliance with applicable National Data regulations and laws including NDMO and PDPL.
  • Assist in Implementing and enforcing corporate data governance and management policies, GIs and standards.
  • Check and monitor data quality, as well as identify, log and manage data quality issues.
  • Work with stakeholders to perform root cause analysis, and resolve data quality issues quickly and effectively.
  • Capture lineage of data and metadata, trace its origin/source, transformations and movement throughout its data lifecycle in order to understand data dependencies, track changes, ensure data integrity and comply with data sharing agreements.
  • Assign appropriate data classifications for data assets based on their sensitivity and criticality.
  • Define user access levels, permissions and sharing agreements, ensure data is accessed only by authorized individuals and is only retained for as long as needed.
  • Assist in the development of business value use cases involving data analytics, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) and uphold ethical standards of AI within their Admin Area.
  • Assess and improve data management processes, identify opportunities for enhancing data quality, efficiency, and governance, and drive initiatives to address gaps or inefficiencies.
  • Engage closely with the Corporate Data Office, Data Custodians, IT, Technology teams and business stakeholders.
  • Spread awareness and know-how of the data management program across respective business area.
  • Support in privacy compliance activities for respective business area by ensuring Data Privacy is embedded into change management processes, assist in performance of Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), increase awareness of the importance of Data Privacy and act as focal point for all Data Privacy enquiries.
  • As the successful candidate you will hold a Bachelor Degree Engineering. Advanced degree is a plus.
  • You will have a minimum of 3 years of experience in data management.
  • CDPM or Data Steward Certifications are a plus.
  • You will be able to demonstrate analytical capabilities
  • You will have effective English communication and technical report writing skills.

O Hospital Maternidade Maria Amélia Buarque de Hollanda integra a Rede de Atenção materno-infantil e ginecológica no Município do Rio de Janeiro. Suas ações tem por objetivo garantir a integralidade na linha de cuidado, visando a ampliação e qualificação do acesso humanizado das gestantes à assistência hospitalar. Seus processos e fluxos assistências estão ancorados no acolhimento com classificação do risco e em Diretrizes Clínicas baseadas em evidências que viabilizam a resolutividade e a qualidade na atenção prestada.

O Serviço possui papel estratégico na atenção perinatal em articulação com os demais serviços da Rede de Atenção à Saúde, articulada com a rede de atenção primária à saúde da AP 1.0 e regiões circunvizinhas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Preparar fórmulas de composições lácteas, hídricas e dietas enterais a serem utilizadas nas diversas áreas, bem como efetuar a higienização de embalagens, bicos, mamadeiras e outros;
  • Preparar fórmulas lácteas enterais, dentro das especificações predeterminadas pelos Nutricionistas;
  • Administrar os insumos para a produção, através da requisição dos produtos, conferência dos mesmos, conservação e separação, com o objetivo de atender a demanda estabelecida;
  • Preparar, identificar, envasar e distribuir fórmulas lácteas e enterais;
  • Preparar sopas, papas sucos de frutas, efetuando a distribuição de acordo com a divisão em porções adequadas, considerando para a distribuição a identificação antecipada de cada paciente que receberá o alimento;

  • Verificar a temperatura ambiente diária e a temperatura dos equipamentos de refrigeração instalados no Lactário, evitando que uma eventual variação brusca na temperatura do ambiente ou do equipamento possa alterar a composição dos alimentos estocados;
  • Zelar pela organização, conservação e limpeza dos utensílios e dependências do local de trabalho utilizado pelo ocupante do cargo, seguindo normas e instruções para manter a ordem e a higiene local;
  • Operar equipamentos obedecendo às instruções de uso, bem como, informar ao superior imediato a necessidade de compra ou reparos de equipamentos ou utensílios que necessitem de reposição a fim de atender a demanda de atividades diárias;

  • Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais - LGPD;

SOBRE A VAGA

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. 1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform - including its own owned and operated global mobile core network, fully fledged in-house developed eSIM technology, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses - 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide.

We serve many of the world's leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, global fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally , enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues in 2025 exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million , we generate strong cash flows to fund our growth allowing us to continuously invest in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own aspirations to offer telecommunications services to their clients.

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs, Hakan Koçand Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications . We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.

Requirements

  • Knowledge of 3GPP, GSMA, ITU standards and specifications

  • Understanding about IMS architecture. Knowledge about VoIP, VoLTE, VoWiFi, and QoS

  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot networks errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus

Nice-to-haves

  • Bilingual written and verbal skills; English and Portuguese. Spanish is optional.

  • Able to present and defend intelligence positions to a variety of audiences and stakeholders.

  • Travel, as required.

LP is responsible for providing both day-to-day in-field occupational and process safety support to Saudi Aramco operations, as well as centralized technical support and consulting function. Our field offices are located in Abqaiq, Riyadh, Ras Tanura, Dhahran, Udhailiyah, Jeddah (including Yanbu and Jazan), and Tanajib. Through these offices, LP provides its services to all Saudi Aramco facilities and departments that are located throughout the Kingdom.

Your primary role is to embed principles of human and organizational factors in operational process and capital projects, promote a sound safety culture, build human factors capability in the company and share human factors knowledge as well as engage with the industry.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Develop corporate policies, guidelines, standards and specifications for human factors.
  • Develop tools to incorporate human factors in qualitative and quantitative risk assessments (e.g., human failure analysis, safety critical task analysis, human reliability analysis) as well as support risk assessment activities that involve these tools.
  • Introduce human performance tools to error-proof routine and non-routine field activities, including embedding human factors thinking into the day-to-day activities (e.g., site inspections, work permitting, pre and post job briefings, JSA).
  • Participate, review and analyze human factors issues in incident investigations.
  • Advise on Human Factors Engineering (HFE) integration in capital projects, verifying compliance with international and company HFE standards as well as Human-Machine Interface (HMI) specifications.
  • Streamline critical communications for frontline workers, advising on shift turnover practices, communication interfaces between work group and between organizations.
  • Advise facilities on how to manage fatigue risk and best practices in shift work schedule design, including safe manning levels, optimal workload and allocation of functions.
  • Develop programs and strategies for driving and sustaining a positive safety culture, operationalizing proven methods to assess safety culture, and driving targeted interventions.
  • Develop methods to measure psychological safety and action plans to address areas for improvement.
  • Identify and lead the deployment of innovative technologies to reduce human failure.
  • Provide awareness as well as technical training for different human factors topics.
  • Mentor other LP personnel.
  • You will hold a Bachelor degree in Engineering, industrial psychology, human factors, ergonomics, or safety from an Accredited Institution.
  • You will have 7 years of experience as a human factor professional in the oil and gas, petrochemicals, or related industries, including as strong track record in delivering results.
  • You will hold a recognized certification in human factors such as Certified Human Factors Professional (CHFP), Certified Professional Ergonomist (CPE), Chartered Ergonomics and Human Factors Specialist (C.ErgHF), or European Ergonomist (Eur.Erg).
  • You will have an excellent ability to communicate in English with peers as well as members of management, and be able to produce clear and concise oral and written reports in English.

Derq is an MIT spinoff building AI-powered traffic safety and smart infrastructure. We're a team of passionate innovators, leveraging the latest in AI and technology to transform the future of mobility. Our platform enhances road safety and traffic management by turning real-time data into actionable insights for cities and road operators. Our patented technology collects and analyzes data from connected sensors like cameras, radar, and traffic signal controllers to help predict and prevent road incidents. We deploy edge and cloud solutions that make intersections and highways safer and smarter.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Deployment & Maintenance Software Engineer to support the setup, deployment, and ongoing reliability of our software and hardware across client projects. In this role, you will manage server configurations, oversee deployments, monitor live systems, and help keep performance and uptime high. You will work closely with Project Management, Software Systems, and System/DevOps teams to troubleshoot issues, improve configurations, and continuously raise the quality of what we deliver after go-live.

Key Responsibilities

  • Configure and maintain Derq's software for stable, optimal performance
  • Troubleshoot and resolve server issues quickly to minimize downtime
  • Plan and execute software releases, updates, and security patches
  • Ensure configurations are consistent, compliant, and repeatable across deployments
  • Deploy and set up software on new hardware and new sites efficiently
  • Monitor deployed systems and continuously improve performance and uptime
  • Identify process gaps and implement practical improvements to speed up deployments and reduce incidents
  • Maintain clear documentation for configurations, deployments, and system status
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to support smooth integrations and issue resolution
  • Troubleshoot deployment and network issues using standard tools (e.g., SSH, ping, traceroute)
  • Participate in occasional shifts to support global clients and maintain reliability

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, or similar)
  • 2-3 years of experience in server configuration, maintenance, and deployments
  • Hands-on experience in Linux/Ubuntu environments, including:
  • Basic Bash scripting (e.g., creating folders, generating multiple files)
  • Basic Python scripting for automation
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including:
  • SSH and secure connections (ports, authentication methods)
  • Public vs private IP addresses
  • TCP vs UDP
  • Routing concepts (static vs dynamic)
  • NAT, port forwarding, and port mapping
  • Strong troubleshooting skills with a practical, step-by-step approach to resolving connectivity issues and server downtime
  • Familiarity with common diagnostic tools (e.g., ifconfig/ipconfig, ping, traceroute)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work well with cross-functional teams
  • Willingness and ability to overlap 4-5 hours daily with global teams for collaboration, with on-call support if needed (stable power and reliable internet required for remote work)
  • High learning agility and comfort adapting to new tools, systems, and processes

Good to have

  • Understanding of hardware components and on-site infrastructure
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • Familiarity with virtualization and containerization (e.g., VMware, Docker)
  • Exposure to configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible, Puppet, Chef)

description:
Descrição

Acompanhar e/ou implementar os programas de segurança, proteção e meio ambiente, seguindo ou produzindo os seguintes processos: PGR, CIPA, CAT, DDS etc., fiscalizando e acompanhando o uso dos EPI ́s, controlando a data de expiração dos equipamentos e materiais, elaborando relatórios fotográficos, além de palestras e integrações de novos funcionários.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Distribuir diariamente aos colaboradores, os EPI`s que serão usados, recolhendo aqueles danificados e separando-os, anotando na ficha pessoal de cada colaborador o que foi retirado e qual a data do trâmite, para fins de enviar uma notificação ao Auxiliar Administrativo para posterior compra, cumprimento da legislação e preservação da integridade física do colaborador;
  • Fazer levantamento diário do estoque de todo o material de segurança do trabalho (entradas e saídas), anotando em planilha manual a relação dos materiais que faltam, repassando ao Administrativo, para fins de reposição de estoque;
  • Visitar diariamente as áreas operacionais, para fins de inspecionar a segurança nas áreas;
  • Fazer vistoria de veículos mensalmente, verificando pessoalmente os freios, faróis e etc., informando aos Terceirizados caso haja necessidade de algum reparo, lançando em planilha feita no Word os problemas relacionados ao veículo e enviando ao Gerente de Filial os problemas encontrados, para fins de manter os veículos em boas condições e segurança dos colaboradores;
  • Fazer análise de risco baseando-se nas atividades que serão feitas pelas equipes, definindo qual será o EPI usado, qual o processo mais seguro para a realização da atividade, enumerando os possíveis riscos, para fins de preservar a integridade física dos colaboradores;
  • Fazer diariamente a inspeção de segurança, especificando as não conformidades existentes nos locais, fazendo um relatório e encaminhando ao Gerente de Filial ou à empresa responsável, para fins de preservar a integridade física do colaborador e do Meio Ambiente;
  • Responsável por elaborar todo trâmite relacionado à eleição da CIPA e os documentos, exigidos pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, para fins de atender a fiscalização trabalhista;
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente;
  • Controlar mensalmente o SESMT, número de acidentes ocorridos em cada setor, através de notificação do ocorrido, reunindo as CATS, análise de levantamento de acidentes, fazendo um parâmetro e calculando as horas perdidas, total de cada setor, enviando as cópias ao Gerente de Filial e a empresa CSN, para fins de controle do número de acidentes e as horas perdidas;
  • Notificar eventualmente, através de comunicado feito em planilha Excel, uma análise do acidente ocorrido através de simulações ou depoimentos, traçando medidas corretivas, enviando ao Supervisor de área em que ocorreu o acidente, para fins de prevenir acidentes com a mesma proporção;
  • Preencher eventualmente no site do INSS, uma CAT no prazo máximo de quarenta e oito horas após o acidente, informando a lesão ocorrida, o local e a hora, o agente causador, a situação causadora, imprimindo uma cópia e arquivando, fornecendo cópia ao colaborador, e enviando através do site do INSS, para fins de comunicar ao INSS, preservar o colaborador de possíveis dificuldades trabalhistas e a empresa de possíveis processos trabalhistas;
  • Coordenar eventualmente a troca ou efetiva recarga de extintores, inspecionando um a um, mantendo contato direto com a empresa responsável pela manutenção dos extintores para fins da Triunfo estar preparada caso ocorra algum incêndio;
  • Promover eventualmente a integração dos novos colaboradores, apresentando os riscos a que estão expostos, ensinando os procedimentos e análises de riscos, fazendo um treinamento total, apresentação através de Power Point, dando palestras em sala de reuniões, apresentando-os aos seus Supervisores, para fins de mostrar os riscos aos novos colaboradores, apresentar-lhes as responsabilidades e obrigações dentro da empresa;
  • Elaborar mensalmente no Word, gerando cópias e distribuindo em locais de livre acesso aos colaboradores um jornal interno, imputando informações preventivas e atualidades, para fins de fornecer informações e gerar uma integração;
  • Fiscalizar diariamente as Unidades, com o intuito de assegurar que o DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança) está sendo cumprido, arquivando e assinando o DDS, para fins de promover a conscientização e prevenção de acidentes entre os colaboradores;
  • Preencher eventualmente uma planilha enviada pelo Porto de Itaguaí, constando a entrada e a saída de resíduos da oficina, entregando ao Chefe de Oficina, que é responsável pelo recolhimento, para fins de conformidades junto à FEEMA;
  • Representar eventualmente, a empresa na CPATP (Comissão de Prevenção de Acidentes de Trabalhadores; Portuários), participando de reuniões ordinárias e semestrais para fins de justificar problemas e tomar as devidas providências;
  • Planejar, coordenar, orientar tecnicamente, avaliar e realizar estudos, avaliações e inspeções das condições de trabalho, quanto aos aspectos de higiene industrial, segurança industrial e meio ambiente, em áreas, equipamentos, instalações.
  • Elaborar documentação necessária para a abertura da Comunicação de Acidente de Trabalho e encaminhar para o Setor de Recursos Humanos para que seja emitida;
  • Orientar os membros da CIPA para os assuntos ligados a saúde e higiene, através da participação em reuniões e da realização de palestras na semana de prevenção da empresa, visando prevenir doenças e acidentes do trabalho;
  • Indicar e orientar a implementação de medidas preventivas de segurança em toda área industrial, administrativa e proteção ao meio ambiente;
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente;
  • Fazer plano de ação para cumprimento do Anexo SMS escopo do Contrato, apresentando evidências para PETROBRAS;
  • Participar de programas de auditorias de SMS, segurança industrial e de meio ambiente, acompanhar as atividades operacionais nas áreas contratuais, visando à segurança do profissional envolvido, bem patrimonial e meio ambiente;
  • Investigar a analisar acidentes e ocorrências anormais, planejando e executando Plano de Ação trazendo segurança nas operações;
  • Elaborar planos de contingência e coordenar atividades de controle de emergências para todas as áreas contratuais, proceder de acordo com os padrões técnicos e normas operacionais.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho;

description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Fire Protection Engineer to join our Fire Operations Technical Support Group.

Fire Operations Technical Support Group is responsible for providing engineering and technical support to fire operations to protect Saudi Aramco’s critical infrastructure by delivering cutting‑edge fire prevention strategies, emergency response protocols, and deploy large scale suppression systems tailored to high‑risk industrial environments.

Your primary role is to provide specialized technical support for industrial fire operations, focusing on tank firefighting operations, HazMat and foam‑based suppression systems/material. Your expertise will ensure deployment of effective equipment and resources in response to complex fire scenarios while minimizing operational downtime and environmental impact.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Provide technical expertise in industrial fire operations, emphasizing tank firefighting, HazMat response, and foam‑based suppression methods.
  • Assess fire risks in high‑hazard facilities (e.g., refineries, tank farms, processing units) and recommend mitigation strategies.
  • Conduct acceptance testing of foam resources and systems to ensure compliance with National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) standards.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to design fire safety protocols aligned with evolving international standards.
  • Demonstrate leadership by training personnel on advanced firefighting techniques, equipment utilization, and incident command systems.
  • Develop tactical response plans for complex scenarios, such as tank fires, flammable liquid spills, and multi‑agency coordination.
  • Evaluate operational readiness of firefighting units to ensure alignment with NFPA and global best practices.

Position Overview

The Wireless Domain Architect is a senior, hands‑on technical leadership role within a professional IT services organization, serving as the technical authority for enterprise wireless architecture . This position demands expertise in Arista’s next-generation wireless platforms , with demonstrable experience designing, deploying, and supporting Arista Cognitive Wi‑Fi and CloudVision Cognitive Unified Edge (CV-CUE) solutions.

The role blends solution design, field deployment leadership, pre‑sales technical scoping, and escalation support , operating as both an architect and hands‑on technical mentor to delivery teams.

Core Responsibilities

Wireless Architecture & Design

  • Serve as the primary wireless domain expert , with deep, hands‑on experience in Arista Wireless architecture, hardware, and cloud‑managed technologies .

  • Design enterprise‑grade wireless solutions leveraging Arista’s cognitive networking capabilities, including:

    • CloudVision Cognitive Unified Edge (CV-CUE) centralized management, orchestration, and AI/ML‑driven automation planes.

    • Cognitive Wi‑Fi platforms that provide data‑driven telemetry, real‑time analytics, and automatic optimization of wireless connections as network conditions evolve.

    • Multi‑radio, multifunction AP deployments with support for cutting‑edge standards such as Wi‑Fi 6E and Wi‑Fi 7 , zero‑touch onboarding, and high‑density coverage models.

  • Develop high‑level and low‑level wireless designs (HLDs/LLDs) incorporating:

    • RF design, capacity planning, AP placement, and cognitive tuning mechanisms.

    • Zero Trust and WIPS security configurations integrated with cloud orchestration.

    • Flexible data path options and scalable control‑plane architectures inherent to CloudVision’s cognitive approach.

Deployment Leadership & Technical Execution

  • Lead and direct wireless deployment efforts in customer environments and ensure alignment to Arista cognitive design principles .

  • Mentor and guide junior engineers through:

    • Zero‑touch provisioning and onboarding of Arista AP platforms via CV-CUE .

    • Implementation of AI/ML‑enabled analytics and automated remediation features.

    • Integration of AP connectivity with hosted identity management and external NAC solutions.

  • Validate configurations and deployments to ensure stable, optimized performance across cognitive AP platforms and centralized CloudVision management.

Pre‑Sales Scoping & Technical Support

  • Participate in pre‑sales scoping calls with sales and delivery leadership.

  • Provide detailed input on:

    • The effort required to transition customers from legacy Wi‑Fi environments to Arista, Cisco, Aruba and other OEM's or managed architectures .

    • Level of Effort (LOE) estimation for discovery, design, deployment, optimization, and cutover phases.

  • Validate technical assumptions for proposals and SOWs based on real experience with Arista cloud‑native wireless technologies.

Escalation & Customer Assurance

  • Serve as the escalation point for delivery issues related to:

    • Wi‑Fi behavior under load and real‑world spectrum conditions.

    • Automation orchestration failures or troubleshooting of AI/ML‑driven recommendations.

    • Cross‑domain issues spanning wired/wireless convergence and identity enforcement.

  • Engage directly in customer escalation calls to remediate issues, restore confidence, and guide recovery.

Required Technical Expertise (Priority Order)

  • Arista Wireless – REQUIRED / NON‑NEGOTIABLE

    • Hands‑on design, deployment, and operational experience with:

      • Arista Cognitive Wi‑Fi access point platforms (Wi‑Fi 6/6E/7).

      • CloudVision Cognitive Unified Edge (CV-CUE) centralized management and cognitive analytics.

      • AI/ML‑driven automation, telemetry, and troubleshooting inherent to Arista cognitive networking.

  • HPE Aruba Wireless

    • Enterprise Aruba wireless design and deployment experience.

  • Juniper Wireless

    • Familiarity with Juniper Mist and related wireless platforms.

  • Cisco Wireless

    • Experience with Cisco enterprise wireless architectures.

  • Nile Wireless

    • Exposure to or hands‑on experience with Nile wireless solutions.

Required Qualifications

  • Track record of enterprise wireless design and deployment , with at least the majority of experience on Arista cognitive wireless solutions .

  • Demonstrable ability to lead design and delivery teams and mentor engineers in real time.

  • Communication skills to interact confidently with technical and executive stakeholders .

  • Ability to balance design, deployment, and escalation responsibilities simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in IT professional services or consulting.

  • Multi‑vendor wireless migration expertise.

  • Wireless certifications, particularly with Arista technologies.

  • Experience developing technical scoping documentation, proposals, and LOE estimates.

Role Characteristics

  • Combination of technical leadership, hands‑on execution, pre‑sales engagement, and post‑deployment escalation support .

  • Acts as the architectural authority for Arista wireless engagements.

  • Expected to deliver high‑quality outcomes while transferring knowledge to delivery teams.

title: Ubuntu Engineering Lead
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring engineering leaders to work across the breadth of our Ubuntu Engineering organisation - leaders who care deeply for quality, performance and resilience in software, and have a proven track record for building, nurturing and developing high performing engineering teams.

This leadership track includes roles for managers and Senior+ engineers alike. At Canonical, managers are expected to stay technical and close to the code, and our Senior+ engineers lead and develop software projects, as well as the processes and people around them.

Our teams integrate the freshest open source software, provide robust upgrade paths and engineer the future of Ubuntu. Ubuntu is not just the world's most deployed open source operating system, it's a platform that enables innovation for millions of users across the globe. Our community represents the full breadth of the developer experience; from students, hobbyists and freelancers to high performance engineering and creative teams in corporate and academic environments.

Four key teams that ship Ubuntu are the

  • Foundations : maintaining foundational software: architectures, package managers, compilers, toolchains, bootloaders, filesystems and core utilities
  • Server : leading the design, evolution and future of our Ubuntu Server distribution
  • Desktop : driving Ubuntu Desktop, our future immutable desktop: Ubuntu Core Desktop, WSL, gaming technology, and a suite of modern applications for the desktop crafted with Flutter
  • Debcrafters : a new team responsible for the forward movement, maintenance and overall health of the Ubuntu archive: one of the most abundant repositories of open source software available today

You'll be accountable for your technical roadmap, and responsible for your team: helping them grow as engineers, do important and satisfying work, and have a great time while doing it. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

At Canonical, you will have the opportunity to engage with and contribute to the broader open source community. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community and contribute with enthusiasm and precision to a broad range of technologies.

Location

We have remote roles open in every time zone.

Role entails

  • Leading their teams in elevating the Linux developer and user experience
  • Designing, building and shipping high quality, performant software in Rust, Go and Python
  • Demonstrating sound engineering principles through architecture, development and code reviews
  • Taking responsibility for planning, estimation and execution
  • Working with product management to define the vision and strategy for Ubuntu
  • Setting expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Offering coaching, mentoring, technical feedback and hands‑on career development
  • Contributing to upstream and neighboring open source projects
  • Optimizing the distribution for performance, reliability, and security
  • Debugging complex system‑level issues and delivering robust solutions
  • Authoring and improving technical and community documentation

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Ability to drive and deliver technical work streams going above and beyond expectations
  • Lead and coach others to deliver exceptional engineering work
  • A demonstrated passion for open source software
  • Significant experience with Rust, Go, Python, Flutter or C/C++
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Result‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Nice‑to‑have skills

  • Experience contributing to or leading open source projects
  • Experience with Linux distributions/distribution engineering
  • Experience with software packaging and distribution mechanisms
  • Performance or Security Engineering experience

What we offer you

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
